• The word **"restaurant"** means a place where people pay to sit and eat meals that are cooked and served on the premises. (रेस्टोरेंट)

 
 
• **Example: **They decided to celebrate their anniversary at a fancy restaurant.
 
 
 
• **"Delicious" **refers to food that has a very pleasant taste or smell. (स्वादिष्ट)
 
 
• **Example: **The cake she baked was absolutely delicious.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.
